# BSC (Bharat Steel Group) — Sales Call Knowledge Base (auto-distilled)

## Corpus summary
The analyzed corpus consists of approximately 75 call recordings from BSC (Bharat Steel Group / Bharat Steels), operating out of Chennai (yard/office located in Vichur / Thirunilai village near Manali, Ponneri Taluk). 

Of the recorded calls:
- **~35 calls are genuine sales negotiations:** inbound buyer enquiries, pricing discussions, grade/dimension feasibility checks, counter-offers, credit term refusals, and dispatch confirmations handled primarily by internal sales executive Varsha (alongside mentions of Aarthi, Archana, Vijayalakshmi, and MD Gaurav).
